item.title: These Generals Fought for Israel. Now They See ‘Jewish Terrorism’ as the Threat.
item.description: A growing number of former Israeli generals, intelligence officials and prime ministers are accusing settlers in the West Bank of committing ethnic cleansing with government support. “Once a society behaves this way,” one said, “that society is doomed.”

item.title: Mansour Abbas Recruits Yoav Segalovitz to Join Raam Party in Israeli Election
item.description: Mansour Abbas has recruited a Jewish lawmaker best known for reducing the crime rate in Arab cities. Could that be enough to get Mr. Abbas a seat in the next government?

item.title: Your Iran Questions, Answered
item.description: Today, we hand the mic over to reporters covering diplomacy, the White House, the Middle East and more.

item.title: China or the U.S.? Two Meetings Offer Competing Showcases of Global Power.
item.description: As Xi Jinping gathered with the leaders of Russia and Iran, Europe challenged the Trump administration at the G20, offering a split-screen view of a changing world.

item.title: U.S. Sanctions on Iran Cut Off Students from Tests Needed for Study Abroad
item.description: The latest measures have forced the cancellation of English proficiency and graduate exams, isolating many Iranians most eager to foster ties with the world.

item.title: Israel and Greece Reach $3.5 Billion Defense Deal
item.description: Despite the growing diplomatic isolation of the government, the agreement makes clear that the Israeli defense industry is still finding considerable demand abroad.

item.title: A Factory in Rural Ireland Is at the Center of a Dispute Over Russia
item.description: Alumina processed at a refinery in County Limerick may be feeding Russia’s war in Ukraine, an investigation suggested. There is little agreement on what to do about it.

item.title: U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln to Dock in Thailand on Wednesday, Pattaya Mayor Says
item.description: The U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln became an emblem of the strains of the war on the U.S. military. Now its crew will have some rest.

item.title: Nonstop Russian Drones Make for Dangerous New Phase of War in Kyiv
item.description: The nearly constant air raids, a shift from years of largely overnight attacks, have left residents exhausted and on edge.

item.title: Warring Cartels Target Women in Mexico
item.description: A two-year war between rival Sinaloa Cartel factions is driving a surge in killings and disappearances targeting women.
